name: Architectural Ensemble of the Trinity Sergius Lavra in Sergiev Posad
description: The Trinity Sergius Lavra is a working Orthodox monastery in Sergiev Posad, about 70 kilometres northeast of Moscow, and the spiritual heart of the Russian Orthodox Church. Behind its fortress-like walls and towers stand richly decorated churches, including the Cathedral of the Assumption, where Boris Godunov is buried. Over 300 monks live here, and Andrei Rublev's famed Trinity icon is among its treasures.
